crossRefs.note: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named…

people.name: Joppa
people.line: An ancient seaport, the main port for Jerusalem

people.name: Simon
people.line: A tanner in Joppa who hosted Peter.

translations.web: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
translations.bsb: And Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, that he abode many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
